features.name: User authentication (BetterAuth + D1)
features.notes: BetterAuth v1.4.19 with Drizzle adapter. Lazy singleton getAuth() — D1 binding only available per-request via getCloudflareContext. Integer timestamps in schema (D1 rejects Date objects). Cookie-presence proxy.ts guard (Edge Runtime can't call getCloudflareContext; full validation in API routes). Production migration applied via --command. BETTER_AUTH_SECRET + BETTER_AUTH_URL secrets set in Cloudflare.
